findings.title: Re‑entrancy in unstake() allows theft of other users' ether
findings.offending_expression: (bool ok, ) = msg.sender.call{value: amount}(""); require(ok, "eth transfer failed"); totalStaked -= amount; stakeOf[msg.sender] = 0;

patch.label: 修補已通過驗證（針對此攻擊）
patch.rationale: The re‑entrancy bug stemmed from clearing state after the external call. Moving the state updates before the call (Checks‑Effects‑Interactions) prevents an attacker from re‑entering and stealing additional ether.

note: 已證實可攻擊的判定附可重跑的攻擊證據；其他判定都不代表合約沒有漏洞。
